title: Kevin Hassett CAUGHT LYING as CNBC Host FACT-CHECKS Him LIVE
description:
In this in-depth breakdown and reaction to CNBC Television’s coverage of the national economic landscape, White House National Economic Council Director Kevin Hassett joins CNBC anchor MacKenzie Sigalos to address the most pressing issues defining today’s financial reality. From the ongoing debate over economic momentum and persistent consumer price pressures to the massive wave of artificial intelligence adoption and emerging labor market friction, this broadcast captures a pivotal moment of debate over where the American economy is truly headed.

### Economic Leadership and the Cost of Living Debate

The interview opens with a central question facing policymakers: how should the public evaluate the current state of the national economy? While executive officials point toward robust GDP projections and rising corporate profitability, significant focus remains on the cumulative impact of inflation on average households over the past several years. Even as annual inflation rates cool and real wage gains are reported, consumer sentiment continues to reflect the lasting strain of elevated prices across essential categories like housing, groceries, utilities, and everyday goods. The discussion examines whether macroeconomic data fully captures the financial lived experience of working-class families or if structural cost-of-living challenges continue to overshadow headline growth numbers.
